propertySets.name: Pset_ElementAssemblyTypeDilatationPanel
propertySets.definition: Adjustment switch panel properties used in railway. The property set can be used by the predefined type DILATATION_PANEL of IfcElementAssembly.

properties.name: TechnicalStandard
properties.definition: The technical standard which the element should comply with.

properties.name: DilatationLength
properties.definition: Length dilatation admitted by the element.

properties.name: ExpansionDirection
properties.definition: The expansion direction, e.g. single direction, bi-direction

properties.name: InstallationPlan
properties.definition: Reference to external information source about installation or construction plan of the element.
